mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.user_code, u.user_name, m.role, m.status FROM byai.tenant_user_membership m JOIN byai.po_users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} ORDER BY m.joined_at, m.user_id
SELECT params_value FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND params_code = 'PACKAGE_CONTENT_SNAPSHOT' FOR UPDATE
SELECT params_value FROM byai.tenant_config WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND params_code = 'PROVISION_STATE'
SELECT user_id, user_code, user_name FROM byai.po_users WHERE user_code = #{userCode} AND state = 'A'

SELECT m.user_id, u.user_code, u.user_name, m.role, m.status FROM byai.tenant_user_membership m JOIN byai.po_users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM byai.tenant_user_membership WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai.tenant_user_membership (membership_id, enterprise_id, user_id, role, status, created_by) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, 'MEMBER', 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy})
